$comment: Phase 05 (Core Application Runtime) resolved against repository artefacts: architecture/phase-05-core-application-runtime.md (now with addendum HD), frontend/src/lib/kernel/phase-contracts/phase-05-application-runtime.ts, registry row 05, and the twelve runtime-* modules.

documentIntegrity.finding: The document stated 19 of the 20 mandatory engineering sections; the knowledge/self-description section was absent. Addendum section HD (Runtime Knowledge) was authored in the document's own lettered style, stating what the runtime knows about itself, that it is exercised rather than asserted, and that runtime knowledge never becomes domain truth.

ownership.note: Phase 05 owns the execution fabric only (document 'HC. FINAL SCOPE LOCK'): it executes capabilities, it never owns their meaning. Identity 02, tenancy 03, security 08/09, agents 07/24 and every domain phase keep their authority.

areas.requirement: Every request establishes an authorised context (actor, tenant, correlation) before any use case executes.
Commands are validated (including the idempotency requirement) and queries are paged with a declared maximum.
Long-running work becomes a job with bounded, observable retries instead of an unbounded request.
Events are typed, versioned and only consumed by consumers that declare the version.

areas.area: Circuit breaking, rate limiting and timeouts
areas.requirement: Failure is contained: circuits open and recover, windows deny and reset, timeouts are per-operation.

areas.area: Webhook signature, retry and delivery tracking
areas.requirement: Inbound and outbound webhooks are signature-validated, retried with bounds and delivery-tracked.
Every external system is reached through a registered adapter with a declared status, never by direct vendor calls.
Capabilities can be enabled per context, including tenant overrides and a kill switch, without redeploying.
Operations that require human approval hold an approval lifecycle and an operation tracker rather than executing silently.
Batch work respects declared limits, reports partial failure and tracks transfers instead of failing opaquely.
Structured, correlated logs, metrics and health are available to every execution path.
areas.boundaryNote: The observability primitive is proven by tests but no runtime path emits it yet (shared finding P01-1/P03-3). Reported, not glossed.

areas.requirement: The runtime can describe and exercise its own execution fabric — capabilities, jobs, events, approvals, command/query and resilience — without claiming domain truth.
areas.boundaryNote: The `/super-admin/runtime-contracts` L4 surface was removed with the hardcoded console UI (2026-10-26). `runtime-self-report` and its tests remain; projection is IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED until a governed replacement surface exists.
